name: TVA on construction
review_status: Rates read in the official text of Legea 141/2025. The extension of the 9 percent housing rate by Legea 161/2026 is taken from legal commentary and has not been read in the official text.
references: Legea 227/2015, Codul fiscal, art. 291 (cotele de TVA), as amended by Legea 141/2025 art. I pct. 42 (https://static.anaf.ro/static/10/Anaf/legislatie/L_141_2025.pdf)
Legea 141/2025 art. III, transitional 9 percent rate for dwellings
Legea 161/2026, extension of the 9 percent housing rate to 30.09.2026 (reported by https://www.juridice.ro/840847/senat-tva-la-locuinte-ramane-9.html)
description: TVA is 21 percent at the standard rate and 11 percent at the reduced rate from 1 August 2025, when the earlier 19, 9 and 5 percent rates were replaced. A dwelling of up to 120 square metres and 600,000 RON sold to an individual under a contract signed before 1 August 2025 keeps a transitional 9 percent rate, extended to 30 September 2026. Construction works themselves are not on the list of supplies under the domestic reverse charge in art. 331: a contractor invoices TVA to its client in the normal way.
practice_notes: Unit prices in a deviz are net of TVA, which is added on the summary
The reverse charge in art. 331(2) g) concerns the supply of buildings and land taxed by option or by law, not construction services
